column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: the package is built, inspected and packed, the suite runs, and the library's own trace and spec kit are held
mizan-profiles.test.ts, trace.test.ts: the rules are plugins whose findings are held by one baseline
mizan-changes-pure.test.ts: the change-control rules run as plugins of the harness
trace.test.ts, host-trace.test.ts: the trace and the layers of a ladder over files read by the host module
mizan-integrations.test.ts, mizan-integrations-formats.test.ts, mizan-exporters.test.ts: importers and exporters give the same bytes for the same input
mizan-newer.test.ts: a standard newer than its pin is a finding, and nothing is fetched but through the command's own function
mizan-boundaries.test.ts: the modules import only core, crypto, formats, githost, ontology, rdf, system and node:process and node:url
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the tarball, runs every entry on Node 26 and Bun and type-checks a consumer
